familyTree.title: The AI Family Tree
familyTree.subtitle: Artificial Intelligence isn't just one single technology. It's a nested hierarchy of concepts. Hover over the rings or click the cards below to see how they fit inside each other.
familyTree.hint: Click a card to highlight its position in the nested system

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
ai.description: The broadest umbrella. Any technology that lets machines simulate human-like reasoning, matching, or puzzle-solving.

ml.title: Machine Learning (ML)
ml.description: A subset of AI where computer systems learn rules directly from historical examples, bypassing hand-written code rules.

dl.title: Deep Learning (DL)
dl.description: A deeper layer of ML using stacked artificial "neural networks" to automatically master complex structures like human voices or faces.

genai.title: Generative AI (GenAI)
genai.description: The newest inner-core. AI systems trained on massive content maps to create entirely fresh images, writings, or audio tracks.

supervised.title: Supervised Learning
supervised.description: You feed the machine labeled pictures (like "dog" or "cat") until it learns which visual clues match which label.

unsupervised.title: Unsupervised Learning
unsupervised.description: The machine groups unlabeled data by itself, spotting hidden structures or similarities you might have missed.

reinforcement.title: Reinforcement Learning
reinforcement.description: The machine operates in a trial-and-error loop, earning points for correct moves (like teaching a dog with treats).

deeperDetails.aiConcepts: Rule-based expert systems, static decision trees, and custom pattern matchers. AI doesn't always have to learn on its own; it can follow hand-written, smart logical pathways.
deeperDetails.aiExamples: Chess computers (IBM Deep Blue), automated route planning, logic solver programs.
deeperDetails.aiTip: Think of basic AI as a massive, pre-drawn map. The computer is super fast at finding roads on the map, but it cannot draw a single new road by itself.
deeperDetails.mlConcepts: Feature vectors, weights, linear regression, and classifiers. ML allows systems to optimize algorithms dynamically as more training files are parsed.
deeperDetails.mlExamples: Email spam detection, credit scoring, product recommendation engines.
deeperDetails.mlTip: ML is like training a dog by giving it treats for good behavior. The algorithm gets 'points' for correct predictions until it masters the skill.
deeperDetails.dlConcepts: Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) with deep hidden layers. Activations propagate forward, errors are sent back to adjust neural weights automatically.
deeperDetails.dlExamples: Face recognition (Apple FaceID), real-time speech translation, autonomous vehicle vision.
deeperDetails.dlTip: Deep Learning uses a hierarchy of virtual filters. Early layers spot basic lines and edges, middle layers group them into shapes, and final layers see full objects.
deeperDetails.genaiConcepts: Generative models, Large Language Models (LLMs), attention mechanisms, and Transformers. They map world content to synthesize entirely new combinations.
deeperDetails.genaiExamples: Gemini, ChatGPT, Midjourney, DALL-E, GitHub Copilot.
deeperDetails.genaiTip: GenAI does not just copy-paste! It learns the deep grammatical or visual 'recipes' of human creation so it can bake entirely fresh outputs from your instructions.

familyTree.quickTakeaway: AI is not one technology but a nested hierarchy: AI (broadest) contains ML, which contains DL, which powers GenAI. Each layer builds on and specializes the one before it.

generativeAI.title: What is Generative AI?
generativeAI.intro: Until recently, AI was mostly used to analyze, sort, or predict values (like spam or stock prices). But Generative AI — a modern branch of Artificial Intelligence designed to synthesize and output entirely new files, such as custom text, realistic images, and original musical tracks, rather than just analyzing existing ones — has opened up creative frontiers.
generativeAI.introHindi: Pehle ke zamane mein AI sirf data analyze, sort, ya predict karne ke liye tha (jaise spam messages ya share market). Lekin Generative AI — Artificial Intelligence ki nayi branch hai jo bina purani files ko copy kiye, bilkul naye mazmoon, photos, aur gaane khud se likh aur bana sakti hai — isne dunya badal di hai.

generativeAI.generativeDefinition: A modern branch of artificial intelligence that generates new content (text, images, music, etc.) based on patterns learned from existing data.
generativeAI.promptDef: The art of writing clear, specific instructions for AI models to generate high-quality outputs.
generativeAI.tokenDef: How likely the next word or token is, based on all previous tokens. ChatGPT predicts one token at a time.
generativeAI.transformerDef: The underlying technology behind modern large language models like ChatGPT and Gemini.
generativeAI.hallucinationDef: When AI generates confident-sounding but false or made-up information.
generativeAI.quickTakeawayGenAI: Generative AI doesn't 'think' like humans. It's a sophisticated prediction machine that learns statistical patterns from training data and generates new sequences based on probability.

prompting.title: Prompting & RAG Strategies
prompting.subtitle: How to talk to AI, and how AI talks to documents

zeroshot.title: Zero-Shot Prompting
zeroshot.definition: Ask the model to do something without showing any examples first.
zeroshot.example: Q: What is photosynthesis? A: [Generates answer from knowledge]

fewshot.title: Few-Shot Prompting
fewshot.definition: Show the model 2-3 examples before asking the actual question.
fewshot.example: Q1: What is X? A1: [Example answer] ... Q2: What is Y? A: [Model follows pattern]

chainofthought.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting
chainofthought.definition: Ask the model to show its reasoning step-by-step before giving the final answer.
chainofthought.example: Think step-by-step: First, ..., Second, ..., Finally, the answer is...

rag.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
rag.definition: Combining document search with text generation to prevent hallucinations.
rag.step1Desc: User asks a question about specific documents or data
rag.step2Desc: System searches the document database for relevant chunks
rag.step3Desc: Retrieved documents are passed as context to the AI model
rag.step4Desc: AI generates answer grounded in actual document content
rag.benefit: RAG ensures AI stays grounded in real data, preventing confident-sounding false answers.
